plan:
# A one-bedroom laneway cottage. Nothing is placed by hand.
plan "Laneway House" {
  units mm
  grid 50
  dims auto all
  let W = 4200        # living-room width
  let L = W + 3300    # overall length
  let D = 6500        # depth

  wall id=north exterior thickness 200 { (0,0) (L,0) }
  wall id=east  exterior thickness 200 { (L,0) (L,D) }
  wall id=south exterior thickness 200 { (0,D) (L,D) }
  wall id=west  exterior thickness 200 { (0,0) (0,D) }
  wall id=hall  partition thickness 100 { (W,0) (W,D) }
  wall id=wet   partition thickness 100 { (W,2500) (L,2500) }

  room id=live at (0,0) size W x D label "Living" uses living
  strip down at (W,0) gap 0 width 3300 {
    room id=bath size 2500 label "Bath" uses bath
    room id=bed  size 4000 label "Bedroom" uses bedroom
  }

  door on north at 2100 width 900 swing into live
  door sliding on south at 2700 width 1800 slide left
  door on hall at 5600 width 800 hinge left swing into bed
  door pocket on hall at 900 width 800 slide right
  window on west at 2400 width 1200
  window on south at W + 1650 width 1600
  window on east at 1250 width 600

  furniture fridge against wall west offset 400 in live
  furniture stove against wall west offset 1200 in live
  furniture kitchen_sink against wall west offset 2000 in live
  furniture table in live centered size 1300x900
  furniture sofa in live anchor right flush size 900x2000
  furniture bed against wall east offset 4500 in bed
  furniture wardrobe in bed anchor top flush size 1800x600
  furniture shower in bath anchor top-right flush size 900x900
  furniture wc in bath anchor bottom-left flush size 400x700
  furniture basin against wall wet offset 2300 in bath
}
